NONE: › to name things separately, one by one

example: He enumerated the benefits of the insurance scheme.
他列出了這項保險方案的種種益處。

I or T: › [ I or T ] to pronounce words or parts of words clearly
清楚地念（字）；清晰地發（音）

T: › [ T ] to express and explain a plan or principle clearly or formally

example: He doesn't enunciate (his words) very clearly.
他（說話）發音不是太清晰。
In the speech, the leader enunciated his party's proposals for tax reform.
在演講中，這位領導人闡明了該政黨的稅收改革計劃。
